name: samarth
description: Samarth Rayar's Claude Code plugins: mods, skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: A live usage cockpit above the prompt: context, plan limits with pace forecasts, and cost by day, week and month, in a one-line glance that expands into tabs and a dashboard pane

plugins.name: pixel-room
plugins.description: A lo-fi pixel room behind the desktop app with the day's weather and the moon at the window, a cat you can pet that sleeps until Claude works, sticky notes for its todo list, moths for its subagents and soft sounds

plugins.name: themes
plugins.description: A theme picker above the prompt: thumbnails of every theme, tried live one click at a time, kept or put back, with each theme's options and an install or remove button
